title: Arcane Dust
text: Mana residue released by analysis can also be cultivated in a Catalysis Chamber. Water is required; the substrate and seed dust remain. It does not grow naturally without water.

Normally right-click budding crystal rock to advance all growable faces one stage, creating buds on empty or source-water faces. One dust is consumed whenever any face can grow; blocked or mature faces alone consume nothing.
Normal use on other blocks places floating Arcane Wires; use on Phase Crystal Clusters stimulates them. Sneak-right-click skips growth and places a wire beside the clicked face instead.
